t: Bees for Tinkers Construct materials. The bees are obtained by pouring a material over a spawn egg in the casting table.
匠魂各种材料的蜜蜂。在铸造台上把材料浇在刷怪蛋上即可获得。
This bee cannot be bred. Spawn egg is crafted from a $(l:bees/wild/slimy)Slimy Bee$(/l) spawn egg using a casting table.
这种蜜蜂无法繁殖。它的刷怪蛋需要用铸造台以一枚$(l:bees/wild/slimy)史莱姆蜜蜂$(/l)刷怪蛋制作。
